title: The feed reads a local page while refresh reaches the backend
caption: Paging coordinates the feed cache and backend. The backend owns ranking and media delivery, while the device integrates configuration, notifications and diagnostics.

title: The device separates catalog, cart and checkout ownership
caption: The server-backed cart has a local view. The payment SDK handles the provider-supported flow, while the backend verifies the order and payment status.

title: The store device owns local work while services verify business outcomes
caption: The device shows orders from local storage, manages peripherals and reconciles card payments with the backend. Card entry stays with the PIN-pad integration.

title: Local data and outbound mutations have one write boundary
caption: The repository gives the UI local state. The sync engine pushes saved mutations and pulls remote changes. The resolver supplies the merged value when a conflict needs it.

title: The bank verifies signed actions beyond the device boundary
caption: Device code owns UI, session and key use. The gateway and bank own validation and the ledger. A local prompt success does not settle a transfer.

title: Trip state stays durable while location updates age out
caption: Rider and driver clients keep local views. The dispatcher feeds matching and trip services. The location index is separate from the durable trip record.

title: Feed, engagement and visible media have separate data paths
caption: Paging and Room provide the feed view. Engagement writes wait in a local outbox. Media and direct messages have their own clients and lifecycle boundaries.

title: Playback and downloads have separate local resources
caption: The player uses the manifest, track selection and DRM as needed. The download path stores segments and manages offline licenses separately. Resume position belongs to a server-backed path.

title: Show the retained page while fresh data arrives
caption: The first page comes from Room while the network refresh runs. The response is written back to the cache before the updated feed takes precedence. The timing shown is illustrative.

caption: The transaction makes the desired like state visible and preserves its outbound work. The outbox sends the saved operation and removes it after acknowledgement.

title: Show the pending cart change and reconcile against the server
caption: The local transaction saves the pending cart update and its operation key. The backend returns the canonical cart, which the client writes back to the local view.

title: Verified payment status decides whether a receipt can appear
caption: Follow one outcome after reconciliation. A verified PAID order gets a receipt, PENDING keeps a status screen and a saved operation, and a confirmed failure preserves the cart for recovery.

title: An order update creates one durable print job
caption: The order and print job are stored together. The worker claims the pending job and records the result. An unknown printer outcome needs reconciliation rather than an assumption that nothing printed.

title: A pending card payment has a different receipt from an approval
caption: Only verified approval leads to a success receipt. Pending authorization or forwarding is labelled pending, including merchant risk where applicable. A verified decline leads to recovery.

title: Commit the local edit and its outbound mutation together

title: Location delivery follows the connection state
caption: Follow one connection path. A live socket can deliver a batch, a dropped socket can use REST when online, and an offline device retains buffered locations for reconnect.

title: Buffered data can cover a short connection loss
caption: Playback can use the available buffer during a drop. On reconnect the player refills it and adapts if the available bandwidth changes. Buffer duration and policy depend on the setup.
